reason: I only pay cash when the thing is in my hand, and here I have to send the item price and fee first to a name I've never heard of. A photo from a warehouse in China doesn't prove anything to me, people show photos and then disappear.
objection: Paying up front with Zain Cash to a brand new page and then waiting 2 to 3 weeks hoping something shows up. If it never comes, who do I chase?
would_change_my_mind: Letting me pay everything cash on delivery, or my sister or a friend getting their order from them first so I see it's real.
